essential_8point — 3D two_view op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.essential_8point(pts1, pts2, K1, K2=None) (to call the implementation directly, import twoview; twoview.essential_8point(pts1, pts2, K1, K2=None); from the registry, ops3d.get("essential_8point"))

Usage

The essential matrix E directly from correspondences and K. → E (3,3).

Procedure: estimate F with fundamental_8point(pts1, pts2), form E = K2ᵀ F K1, then use SVD to replace the singular values with (1, 1, 0) (the property of the essential matrix; the Frobenius norm of the result is fixed at √2).

• K1 (3,3) is the intrinsic matrix of image 1; if K2 is omitted, K1 is used for both images (assumes the same camera).

• Correspondences are (N,2) pixel coordinates. Validation and exceptions are the same as fundamental_8point (fewer than 8 points, mismatched point counts, non-finite, or input that is not (N,2) gives ValueError).

• The sign of E is indeterminate, and (R, t) splits into 4 candidates. recover_pose does the decomposition and the disambiguation by cheirality all together.

• Defenceless against outliers. The planar / pure-rotation degeneracy is not detected by this op either (recover_pose detects it). Deterministic.
